full_judgment: 6. It appears that in the application under Order 9 rule 13A of the Code the petitioner has taken grounds that their tadbirkar had been seriously ill and for it he failed to collect the date of the suit. He could not conduct the appointed Advocate and consequently failed to appear before the Court on the day when it was fixed and called on for hearing. He would suffer irreparable loss and injury, if the case is not restored to the file and number. Since the application under Order 9 rule 13A of the Code was within the period of limitation, the Joint District Judge allowed it with cost to be paid with 10 (ten) working days with default order. But the petitioner failed to deposit the cost within the time prescribed by the Court. He then filed an application under section 151 of the Code to extent the time for depositing the cost which was rejected by the Joint District Judge.
